name: ColorManga
trained_words: make this image into colormanga style
description: About LoRA The new LoRA model of Qwen-edit. It can convert any realistic photo (also supporting 3D and most 2.5D images) into colorful comic-style images. This LoRA has two versions: the one you obtain on CivitAI is its basic version. Meanwhile, I will optimize it based on the test results of the basic version and train a Plus version. The Plus version, as a private model, will be shared with members on my Patreon. You can see the differences between them here differences: Difference in hue In the Base version, the overall image tends to inherit the cyan and cool tones of the original image, while the Plus version tends to have brighter tones. Difference in brightness Because the Plus version tends to have brighter tones, the dark areas of the Base version's images appear relatively darker (the bright areas are basically the same). This is more obvious on men's faces. Of course, some people may think that this makes the image have a stronger sense of layering, which entirely depends on personal preference. Differences in original The Plus version inherits the details from the original image better. Taking this image as an example, in the background at the bottom left corner of the picture, the Plus version depicts a natural landscape, the Base version depicts an urban landscape, while the original image also has a natural landscape. Differences in details Taking this figure as an example, the details of the girl's lips and hair in the Plus version are significantly more than those in the Base version. It needs to be reiterated that the above are only the differences I summarized through hundreds of sets of comparison tests. In actual use, no one will compare pictures one by one like me. In fact, each picture looks very good when viewed individually, and the differences can only be seen when compared. Go to the Plus version One more thing Thanks to the powerful editing capabilities of Qwen-edit, you can completely use it to replace some functions of ControlNet, and you can also use this LoRA to turn any line drawing into a styled illustration. Tips: During the training of this LoRA, Qwen-edit released version 2509. Therefore, all the images displayed are from Qwen-edit, not version 2509.
